timeline.summary: Aylith is not made heir to her father's Memories because she is female.
timeline.quote: Aylith was not made the heir to her father Logan 's Memories because she was female

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nohrish raiders attack Inys Haen; Thix sets it ablaze, Logan passes on the Memories to Aylith and dies.
timeline.quote: The Keeper was able to pass on the Memories of the Clan Tree, making his daughter a Keeper herself

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: RoNal slays Thix and adopts Aylith.
timeline.quote: RoNal , leader of the Nohrish force, slew Thix

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith chooses peace over vengeance and heals Nazir of his family's curse.
timeline.quote: healed him of his family's curse

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith and Nazir recite the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending the fighting.
timeline.quote: a new sapling Clan Tree took root, restoring balance to the plane

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haen is chosen as Keeper of the Tree and sworn to protect it; Nohr grows jealous.
timeline.quote: Nohr grew jealous at his friend's new status.

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haen becomes known as the First, a Keeper without a tree, and plants a warded thornwood wall to defend Inys Haen.
timeline.quote: Haen then became known as the First, a Keeper without a tree to keep

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lorris takes part in the raid on Inys Haen in which Keeper Logan is killed and Aylith imprisoned.
timeline.quote: including in the raid that saw Keeper Logan killed and his daughter Aylith imprisoned

citation.text: "Lorris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lorris corners Nazir at Inys Haen but Jedhian persuades her to take him prisoner; Nazir escapes.
timeline.quote: Jedhian intervened, convincing her to take him prisoner instead.

citation.text: "Lorris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos goes with Nazir to Inys Haen to force the Awakening Ritual, but Aylith's allies arrive and Nazir flees, leaving Malvos behind.
timeline.quote: Malvos remained behind to control the situation

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos grasps Soulslayer when Feryar confronts him; its serpents bite him, he is captured and forced to teach Jedhian, and the blade crumbles.
timeline.quote: the silver serpents embedded in it came to life, sinking their fangs into his flesh

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir tries to reach Inys Haen but his birthmark burns so badly he must turn back.
timeline.quote: his birthmark burned so badly that he had to turn back

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir's soldiers raid Inys Haen and return with Aylith but not the Keeper alive.
timeline.quote: they failed to bring back the Keeper alive but returned with his young daughter, Aylith

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir abandons his fortress and assaults Inys Haen; Aylith pursues him.
timeline.quote: Nazir abandoned his fortress and led his best warriors in an assault on Inys Haen

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir assists the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending his reign.
timeline.quote: Nazir assisted in performing the Awakening Ritual alongside Aylith, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haen awakes and performs the awakening ritual, bringing spring to his lands.
timeline.quote: For several weeks there is no end to the winter until Haen finally awakes.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nohrish soldiers raid Inys Haen to capture the Keeper and Aylith.
timeline.quote: 519 years after the Parting, the destruction of the Clan Tree, Nohrish soldiers descended from the mountains, and launch a raid on Inys Haen

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The capture of Aylith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thix starts fires and attacks Aylith; the Keeper and his wife die and RoNal kills Thix.
timeline.quote: The Keeper and his wife die in the fire and RoNal is forced to kill Thix.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The capture of Aylith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedhian buries Aylith's mother with a discarded sword that is Soulslayer.
timeline.quote: which turns out to be the centuries-lost sword Soulslayer.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The capture of Aylith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos uses Soulslayer and is bitten by its silver snakes; Jedhian heals him at the cost of the sword crumbling.
timeline.quote: His snake tattoos and the silver snakes worked into the sword's hilt to come to life and bite him.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "Counterstrike". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
